description: ERCOT: Unplanned Resource Outages Report is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This report contains a snapshot of all unplanned Resource outages (i.e., Forced Outages and Maintenance Outages) and derates that were active in the Outage Scheduler at any time on the third day before the posting date of this report. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are electric power failures, electricity outages. The portal shows 2024-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ERCOT Terms of Use (https://www.ercot.com/help/terms). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
